info: The single NAS backup task form now enables or disables the recurring schedule and saves its selected targets.<context="release info"/>
Scheduled runs reuse the same task and saved targets without opening the form; API 0.8.0 provides the per-run trigger context.<context="release info"/>
Changed the default to a fixed filtered project copy; timestamped copies and ZIP are configurable.<context="release info"/>
Added verified replacement, target locks, ZIP read-back verification and mode migration documentation.<context="release info"/>
Added dashboard keyboard shortcuts with explicit macOS bindings and usage documentation.<context="release info"/>
Added compact configurable task names with i18x date/time and change symbols.<context="release info"/>
Added a distinct example project title and bundled microGulp logo.<context="release info"/>
Added configurable backup targets, dry run and verified per-target snapshots.<context="release info"/>
Added standalone recipe version validation and package synchronization.<context="release info"/>
